newsitem.title: UK: News Corp ASkyB partner EchoStar Comms - paper.
newsitem.headline: News Corp ASkyB partner EchoStar Comms - paper.

text.p: News Corporation has agreed to link up with the Denver-based U.S. digital satellite broadcaster EchoStar Communications under its plans to to launch ASkyB in the States later this year, the Financial Times said on Tuesday.

The report said News Corp, headed by media mogul Rupert Murdoch, and EchoStar will team up for the launch of ASkyB, a 200 channel digital satellite television service. Together the two partners will be able to offer more than 500 channels plus a range of information and home shopping services, said the report.
EchoStar and ASkyB will trade under the name Sky in the 50/50 joint venture which is seen intensifying competition in the U.S. television market.
